query: INSERT INTO oauth_flows (state_hash, provider, flow_kind, sealed_flow, used_at, expires_at, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULL, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (state_hash) DO UPDATE SET provider = EXCLUDED.provider, flow_kind = EXCLUDED.flow_kind, sealed_flow = EXCLUDED.sealed_flow, used_at = NULL, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
